_doc: The SA-02m-web-build quality-tools registry (PROTOCOL.md `## Quality tools`). The one home for 'what does GREEN mean for this web project'. Each row is a self-contained check the runner (`.ai-dev/quality/run.mjs <beat>`) executes wholesale for its beat. The Builder runs every `build`-beat tool on completion and hands back only when they pass; the Reviewer confirms the `review`-beat tools ran and reads their output; `ship`-beat tools run before the merge stamp. Adding or changing a tool = a row here + (optionally) its native config beside this file — never a runner edit.

_row_shape.checks: one plain line: what this tool catches
_row_shape.config: path to its native config beside this file, or null if none
_row_shape.run: the command to run it (from the project root — the runner's cwd)
_row_shape.covers: optional array of path prefixes/globs; run.mjs --touched runs a row only when the diff touches a covered path (rows without covers always run)
_row_shape.init: one line: how to install/enable it

tools.checks: Syntax errors in every hand-written frontend script — the top-level bundles (app.js, i18n.js, flasher.js, mqtt.js, gateway.js) and the app/*.js modules app.js was decomposed into (F10) — a broken script bricks the whole UI since there is no build step.
tools.run: bash -c 'set -e; for f in www/network_config/static/js/*.js www/network_config/static/js/app/*.js; do node --check "$f"; done'
tools.init: Node 18+

tools.checks: Bash syntax errors in every CGI endpoint and shared lib — a broken CGI returns 500 with no client-side trace.
tools.run: bash -c 'set -e; for f in www/network_config/cgi-bin/*.cgi www/network_config/cgi-bin/lib_*.sh; do bash -n "$f"; done'
tools.init: bash (present everywhere the project builds)

tools.checks: Syntax errors in every on-device Python service under opt/ (the Modbus-MQTT bridge, snapshot/scan/monitor helpers, the flasher) — a broken script fails only at systemd start on the device, with no build step to catch it.
tools.run: bash -c 'for p in python3 python py; do if "$p" -c "import sys"; then exec "$p" -m compileall -q opt/; fi; done; echo py-syntax: no working python interpreter; exit 1'
tools.init: Python 3.10+ as python3, python, or py — same interpreter picker as version-consistency (Windows ships a non-functional python3 Store stub)

tools.checks: Bridge unit tests (opt/sa02m-modbus-mqtt/tests — FMB event manager generalization, MR-02m dispatch golden values, DTV event ranges/scaling) — a regression in the event path passes py-syntax but fails here.
tools.run: bash -c 'for p in python3 python py; do if "$p" -c "import sys"; then exec "$p" -m unittest discover -s opt/sa02m-modbus-mqtt/tests -q; fi; done; echo py-unit: no working python interpreter; exit 1'
tools.init: Python 3.10+ (stdlib unittest, no extra deps) — same interpreter picker as py-syntax

tools.checks: Cloud-agent stdlib unit tests (opt/sa02m-cloud-agent/tests, unittest-style test_render*.py). Despite the pattern name this row now covers the whole agent seam: frpc.toml rendering + the device-side local-port allow-list (drops :22/:1883, keeps :80/:9999) + pinned transport TLS (A5 defense-in-depth), per-device identity metadatas emission and 0600 credential storage, the heartbeat send-only guarantee (threat-model F1), and revocation stand-down/recovery. The test_render*.py pattern deliberately excludes the pytest-style test_agent.py (pytest is not a device/CI dep) — widening it to test_*.py would fail the gate on the missing import.
tools.run: bash -c 'for p in python3 python py; do if "$p" -c "import sys"; then exec "$p" -m unittest discover -s opt/sa02m-cloud-agent/tests -p "test_render*.py" -q; fi; done; echo py-unit-cloud: no working python interpreter; exit 1'
tools.init: Python 3.10+ (stdlib unittest, no extra deps) — same interpreter picker as py-unit

tools.checks: Flasher unit tests (opt/sa02m-flasher/tests, stdlib unittest) — firmware formats/repo, scan persist, MPLC port lease, application-line profiles, and the by-address bootloader reg-290 signature preflight (1.0.5.17). A regression in the flash routing/signature path passes py-syntax but fails here. Uses -t opt/sa02m-flasher so the sa02m_flasher package imports from any cwd.
tools.run: bash -c 'for p in python3 python py; do if "$p" -c "import sys"; then exec "$p" -m unittest discover -s opt/sa02m-flasher/tests -t opt/sa02m-flasher -q; fi; done; echo py-unit-flasher: no working python interpreter; exit 1'
tools.init: Python 3.10+ (stdlib unittest, no extra deps) — same interpreter picker as py-unit

tools.checks: Static gate for docs/contracts/ethernet-iface-naming.md: the legacy-name ledger (only the compat layer, the rename script and the installer migration may name end0/end1 — non-vacuous both ways), the installer still installing AND enabling sa02m-iface-canonical.service, the F6 guard (no `echo -e` in apply.cgi and conf writes only through the two known writers), the §5.4 rm-helper pins (no raw `sudo rm` in apply.cgi; the pinned sa02m-conf-rm.sh sudoers grant present), and the contract §1.0/§7 ordering pins: the unit ordered Before=networking.service, After=+Wants= systemd-udevd + systemd-udev-trigger (else the boot-0 pre-udevd no-op returns), NO Wants=systemd-udev-settle (else the 120 s whole-queue stall returns), fix-eth@.service After=networking.service (else the double-ifup 'File exists' race returns), the rename script still gating canonicalize_pair on udev_initialized (else the boot-0 class returns silently), and 02-network.sh writing `source /etc/network/interfaces.d/*.conf` with no unfiltered `*` line (else <conf>.sa02m-bak backups go live: duplicate stanza -> 'File exists' -> networking FAILED, §1.0 mechanism 3).
tools.init: bash + grep (present everywhere the project builds)

tools.checks: Static gate for docs/contracts/kernel-conditional-services.md: the opcua gateway port default agrees between etc/sa02m-mqtt-opcua.conf and BOTH py defaults and is not 4840 (CODESYS's own OPC UA server owns 4840 — a regression re-creates the EADDRINUSE crash-loop), sa02m-grat-arp@.service stays Type=simple (a oneshot regression re-blocks multi-user.target ~29 s), the kernel-service guard script + unit + docker ExecCondition drop-in exist and 01-system.sh installs/enables them and runs apply-policy, 08-codesys.sh carries no unconditional enable/start of codesyscontrol (install-only policy), service-ctl cmd_start/codesys_install carry no codesys_rc_enable (start = runtime only), the boot-hold pins: sa02m-modem-dhcp@.service stays event-driven (no [Install] — a statically enabled instance holds multi-user ~90 s on an absent modem) with the 99-modem.rules start line and the 01-system.sh stale-symlink cleanup in place, and sa02m-mqtt-opcua.py sends exactly one sd_notify("READY=1") at the top of main() BEFORE `gw = OpcuaGateway(cfg)` (early READY decouples the OPC UA address-space build — ~9 s in OpcuaServer() construction inside __init__, ~17 s total — from multi-user.target; moving it into/after construction reintroduces the boot hold, contract §5.1). Non-vacuous: a missing file or an empty extraction FAILS.
tools.init: bash + grep (present everywhere the project builds)

tools.checks: Functional regression for apply.cgi's /etc/network/interfaces.d foreign-stanza merge: vendor post-up/comment/hwaddress lines preserved verbatim and in order, byte-identical second save (idempotency), unchanged output for a conf with no foreign lines, malformed/duplicate-stanza fallback to backup+regeneration, the 64-line/512-byte/control-char bounds, and the sibling rule (canonical always written, legacy mirrored as allow-hotplug only while live, retired once the device is gone). The merge is Bash inside a CGI, so no other row reaches it — a silent re-break of vendor-hook preservation would otherwise pass every syntax/static gate.
tools.init: bash (stdlib only, no deps) — run on demand: bash scripts/dev/test-iface-conf-merge.sh

tools.checks: Functional regression for the rename script's per-device udev-initialized gate (etc/sa02m-iface-canonical.sh canonicalize_pair, contract §1.0): settled-canonical immediate no-op, initialized-legacy rename, the boot-0 sequence (kernel-named eth0 that udev renames to end0 mid-wait — the 6.1-class 'board unreachable on an unattended boot' regression), absent-pair budget, both degraded-fallback branches (udev db never appears), and the failed-rename exit/admin-state discipline. Runs the SHIPPED functions against a sandboxed SYS_NET/UDEV_DB pair with an `ip` PATH shim — the systemd/udev timing it enumerates is unreachable from any other row and cannot be forced on a healthy bench board.
tools.init: bash (stdlib only, no deps) — run on demand: bash scripts/dev/test-iface-canonical-gate.sh

tools.checks: Regression for the installer's on-disk migration to canonical interface names (scripts/02-network.sh migrate_iface_conf): the three gate branches (canonical device live / explicit --ip protected / DUAL-CONF deferred), DUAL-CONF re-run idempotency incl. the canonical header NOT being demoted to allow-hotplug, a stanza-free legacy conf being dropped rather than copied over the live one, and eth1's allow-hotplug convention. This code only runs on a device as root during an install and its failure mode is 'the board comes up with no address' (the 1.0.3.38 Cannot-find-device class), so it gets a bench-runnable net.
tools.init: bash (stdlib only, no deps) — run on demand: bash scripts/dev/test-iface-migration.sh

tools.checks: Functional regression for the gateway-in-subnet validators in cgi-bin/lib_web_validate.sh (ipv4_to_int/netmask_is_contiguous/same_ipv4_subnet) and the apply.cgi empty-gateway guard: the customer bug (192.168.1.135/24 + gw 192.168.10.1 rejected), in-subnet /24 //16 //25 accepted, out-of-subnet rejected, non-contiguous/zero netmask rejected, leading-zero octet forced base-10 (010 read decimal, not octal), and both interfaces' `[ -n "$GATEWAY" ]` guards present so an empty gateway stays allowed. Pure-Bash math inside a CGI lib no other row reaches — a silent re-open of the dead-route footgun would otherwise pass every syntax/static gate.
tools.init: bash (stdlib only, no deps) — run on demand: bash scripts/dev/test-subnet-validate.sh

tools.checks: Regression for the donor-metadata handoff in tools/imaging/make-image.sh step 6 (collect_donor_metadata -> write_manifest): every field lands in its own manifest slot on a healthy donor whose /proc/device-tree/model is NUL-terminated with NO trailing newline (the field-shift class: a merged or absent line shifts every later field into the wrong slot), on a degraded donor (absent model file, conf without the profile key, failing dpkg-query), plus the donor-supplied serial_profile without the --profile override, a value containing '=', and a malformed DONOR_META. Extracts the SHIPPED collect_donor_metadata remote body and the SHIPPED write_manifest python (extraction anchored to their owning functions — the file carries other heredocs with the same tags) and runs them against a sandboxed fake donor: no ssh, no device, nothing touches the real system. Non-vacuous both ways: an empty or over-captured extraction FAILS, and MAKE_IMAGE_SRC pointed at a pre-fix script fails loudly (see the test header for the recipe).
tools.init: bash + Python 3 as python3/python/py (stdlib only, no deps) — run on demand: bash scripts/dev/test-image-manifest.sh

tools.checks: www/network_config/VERSION, APP_VERSION in app.js, and every ?v= cache-bust string agree with the version-named git branch — a skew ships stale cached assets to devices.
tools.run: bash -c 'for p in python3 python py; do if "$p" -c "import sys"; then exec "$p" scripts/sync-app-version.py --check; fi; done; echo version-consistency: no working python interpreter; exit 1'
tools.init: Python 3.10+ as python3, python, or py — the runner picks the first that actually executes (Windows ships a non-functional python3 Store stub; Linux/CI resolves python3 first)

tools.checks: flasher.js module-signature recognition/caps/route functions (isMpModuleSignatureForFirmwareHint, capsFromSignature, resolveDeviceFlashRoute) against every recognized MR-02m spelling incl. count-first 6AI6AO/AO6AI6 — a regression here silently misroutes bootloader-mode flashing or the RS-485 line profile with no server-side signal.
tools.init: Node 18+ (stdlib only), no extra dep — same posture as the js-unit row.

tools.checks: Frontend logic unit tests the js-syntax `node --check` cannot reach. Currently: clearSessionCookie() in app.js clears session_token at EVERY path prefix (the 401 auto-logout must evict the cloud-scoped Path=/devcfg/<id> cookie, not only Path=/). Stdlib-only Node (no framework), so no extra dep — mirrors the ui-layout row's dep-free/graceful posture.
tools.init: Node 18+ (stdlib only). Run on demand: node scripts/dev/test-clear-session-cookie.mjs

tools.checks: The quality runner's own touched-file detection (computeTouchedFiles() in run.mjs, incl. the last-resort unstaged-git-status fallback used right after branching with no new commits) — a regression there silently degrades --touched scoping to a false-green 0/0 pass instead of running the real subset.
tools.init: Node 18+ (stdlib only, spins up a temp git repo)

tools.checks: Bash syntax of the on-device installer.
tools.init: bash

tools.checks: Real bugs (severity=error) in every Bash surface of the repo — CGI endpoints and shared libs, device scripts, the installer, build/imaging tools (tools/*/), dev harnesses (scripts/dev/), on-device sbin helpers and the quality checks themselves; the exact file set has its one home in the check script. Quoting/word-splitting/unset-var defects are the stated top defect class for this stack (web-code-rigor.md). Style/info/warning are intentionally NOT gated (severity=error only) so the row stays a bug gate, not a lint nag.
tools.init: shellcheck (preinstalled on GitHub ubuntu runners; `apt install shellcheck` / `brew install shellcheck` locally). Absent -> the row skips (exit 0), so Windows/dev boxes without it stay green; the Linux CI is the enforcing run.

tools.checks: Frontend regression smoke via the committed characterization harness (scripts/dev/characterize-ui.mjs --compare baseline): loads the dashboard headless over every tab/theme/variant and diffs globals + new console errors + DOM skeleton against the saved baseline (scripts/dev/baseline/). Catches a JS bundle break or a widget-id/skeleton regression no syntax check sees.
tools.init: cd scripts/dev && npm install && npx playwright install chromium; set SA02M_WEB_PASS and serve/point the harness (scripts/dev/README.md). Absent deps/password -> the row skips (exit 0); it is the on-demand real-layer UI check, not a headless-less CI gate.

tools.checks: Geometry/layout regressions the syntax and characterization rows can't see: renders the dashboard + Управление services-control block across 4 viewports x 2 themes x 2 HW variants and ASSERTS real getBoundingClientRect geometry (never CSS strings) — services column alignment (the 1.0.5.19 grid: manage/toggle/badge each one x-left per row), no horizontal overflow at the supported widths, touch-target sizes vs a printed deviation ledger, no dashboard card overlap. Also writes full-page screenshots per cell to the gitignored .ai-dev/quality/screenshots/ (просмотр вёрстки). Dev-only; never shipped to the device.
tools.init: npm run ui-layout:install (installs the scripts/dev playwright harness + chromium, reused by the driver). Absent chromium/playwright -> the row skips (exit 0), so CI (no browser) stays green; it is an on-demand real-layer layout check, not a headless-less CI gate. Run on demand: npm run ui-layout.
